tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.title: Search Health Insurance Providers
tools.description:
Search the Flexpa Endpoint Directory to find health insurance payers and healthcare providers.

## When to Use
Call this tool when a user mentions their health insurance company, plan, or payer.

## Search Tips
- Search by insurer name: "Aetna", "Cigna", "United Healthcare", "Humana", "Kaiser"
- Search by provider name: "Mayo Clinic", "Cleveland Clinic", "Kaiser Permanente"
- Search by acronym: "BCBS", "UHC", "HCSC"
- Search by state for regional insurers: "Illinois", "Texas", "California"

## CRITICAL: Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Handling
BCBS is a federation of independent companies, NOT a single insurer. Each state has different BCBS entities:
- If user says "Blue Cross", "Blue Shield", or "BCBS", you MUST ask: "Which state is your Blue Cross Blue Shield plan from?"
- Then search for "BCBS [state]" (e.g., "BCBS Illinois", "BCBS Texas")
- Common BCBS entities: BCBS of Illinois, BCBS of Texas, Anthem (CA, IN, others), Highmark (PA, WV, DE), CareFirst (DC, MD, VA)

## CRITICAL: Medicaid Handling
Medicaid is a state-run program with different names and plans in each state:
- If user says "Medicaid", ask: "Which state is your Medicaid coverage from?"
- Then search for the state's Medicaid program name
- Examples: "Medi-Cal" (California), "BadgerCare" (Wisconsin), "Peach State" (Georgia)

## Results
Returns up to 10 matching endpoints with:
- id: Unique endpoint identifier (use this for subsequent API calls)
- name: Internal endpoint name (e.g., "aetna", "bcbs-illinois")
- label: Display names/brands
- organizationName: Full organization name
- organizationType: PAYER, PROVIDER, or VENDOR
- isBCBS: Whether this is a Blue Cross Blue Shield entity
- status: Connection status (only CONNECTED endpoints are usable)

query.description: Search query - insurer name, brand, acronym, or state. Examples: "Aetna", "BCBS Illinois", "United Healthcare", "Humana"

tools.name: get_endpoint_details
tools.title: Get Endpoint Details
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific health insurance endpoint.

## When to Use
Call this after search_endpoints to get full details about a specific endpoint before initiating a connection.

## Returns
- Full endpoint configuration
- Supported lines of business with authentication flow info
- Connection status and availability
- Features like inactive member access, 2FA requirements
- Sign-up links for account registration
- ONC CHPL certified product listings linked to this endpoint (developer name, product, certification status, API docs)

endpointId.description: The endpoint ID from search_endpoints results

tools.name: check_lob_support
tools.title: Check Line of Business Support
tools.description:
Validate if a specific endpoint supports a line of business and determine the authentication flow.

## When to Use
Call this after identifying the endpoint to validate support and get the correct auth flow before initiating connection.

## Line of Business Types
- `medicaid` - State Medicaid programs → OAuth flow
- `medicare_advantage` - Medicare Part C plans → OAuth flow
- `chip` - Children's Health Insurance Program → OAuth flow
- `aca_on_exchange` - ACA Marketplace plans (Healthcare.gov) → OAuth flow
- `aca_off_exchange` - ACA plans bought directly from insurer → OAuth or Credentials flow
- `employer` - Employer-sponsored plans → OAuth or Credentials flow
- `original_medicare` - Traditional Medicare (medicare.gov) → Special endpoint
- `veterans` - VA health benefits → Special endpoint

## CRITICAL: Determining Line of Business
When a user says they have "individual" or "family" plan, you MUST ask:
"Where did you purchase this plan - through Healthcare.gov/state exchange, or directly from the insurance company?"
- Healthcare.gov/State Exchange → aca_on_exchange (OAuth)
- Directly from insurer → aca_off_exchange (OAuth or Credentials)

## Authentication Flows
1. **OAuth Flow**: User is redirected to the payer's login page
2. **Credentials Flow**: User provides username/password within your app

## Returns
- Whether the endpoint supports the LOB
- Which authentication flow to use
- Whether the endpoint is currently connected/available

lineOfBusiness.description: The line of business to check

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.title: List All Connected Endpoints
tools.description:
List all connected health insurance endpoints in the directory.

## When to Use
Use this to get an overview of all available payers or to filter by specific criteria.

## Filters
- status: Filter by connection status (default: CONNECTED only)
- lobType: Filter by line of business support

## Note
This returns a paginated list. For large directories, use search_endpoints with specific queries instead.

lobType.description: Filter by line of business support
